note: Same-type swaps for common ultra-processed staples. Generic product types only; no brand endorsements. Packaged products vary — check labels, including for allergens (FDA).

alternatives.name: Oats, rolled, dry
alternatives.why: Single-ingredient whole grain, ~10 g fiber/100 g vs ~1 g in frosted flakes (FDC); no added sugar.
alternatives.lookFor: Plain rolled or steel-cut oats; ingredient list = oats. Choose 'gluten-free' oats if avoiding gluten.

alternatives.name: Shredded wheat cereal, plain (unfrosted)
alternatives.why: Same type (cold cereal) but whole grain with no added sugar (FDC 0.9 g sugars/100 g).
alternatives.lookFor: Whole grain (e.g. 'whole wheat', 'whole oats') as the FIRST ingredient and no added sugar among the first three ingredients; total carbohydrate-to-fiber ratio under 10:1 (Mozaffarian 2013, USDA criteria compared); the 100% Whole Grain Stamp means all grain is whole and ≥16 g whole grain per serving (Whole Grains Council). DGA 2025-2030: no more than 10 g added sugars per meal. On the Nutrition Facts label, 5% DV or less of sodium/added sugars per serving is low and 20% DV or more is high (FDA).

alternatives.name: Whole-wheat crackers

On the Nutrition Facts label, 5% DV or less of sodium/added sugars per serving is low and 20% DV or more is high (FDA).
